description: Pop-up Bike Lanes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This dataset contains the location and attributes of Pop-up Bike Lanes installed as part of the 'Pop-up Bike Lanes Program'. This information includes the spatial geometry, road name, side of road and the trial start and end dates of the pop-up lane. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are active transport, bicycle, bike, lane, popup. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
